generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of ambulance response (救护车急救). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Stage a calm training demonstration beside the open rear doors of one parked ambulance in daylight. A paramedic stands to the side guiding an empty wheeled stretcher, leaving its frame and wheels visible. Secure the oxygen cylinder inside the vehicle; arrange the closed defibrillator, trauma bag, cervical collar, pulse oximeter and suction unit on separate shelves or ground zones. Fold one foil blanket over the stretcher corner so its metallic material is recognisable. Clinical realism, no patient, blood, panic, logos, numbers or readable medical text.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: ambulance, paramedic, wheeled stretcher, medical oxygen cylinder, automated external defibrillator, trauma bag, cervical collar, pulse oximeter, emergency foil blanket, portable suction unit.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
